summary: In October 2026 autonomous Cairn AI agents directed by a Chinese-speaking attacker compromised the website of an unnamed large hardware-parts vendor. NorForge researchers checked the claimed break-in and found the planted web shell live. The documented chain used unauthorized write access to a memcached session store, unsafe handling of saved PHP objects and a weakness in old Zend Framework code.
